title: Resilient observability Terraform module: log/metric shipping with upgrade health gates
creator: Aisha Khatri
description:
Build a reusable Terraform module for private (VPC) deployments that provisions and manages the observability stack (Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry Collector, and log shipping connectors) with a focus on safe upgrades and automated health gates. The module should be consumable by Private clusters (EKS/GKE/AKS) and by on-prem k8s distributions via Helm and include opinionated defaults for resource limits, sharding, and retention tiers.

Goals:
- Provide a single Terraform module that installs Prometheus (PrometheusOperator/Helm), Grafana (Helm), an OpenTelemetry Collector deployment with pipeline connectors (OTLP recv, metrics exporter, log exporters), and a configurable log-shipping component (Fluent Bit/Fluentd) for S3/CloudWatch/Kafka.
- Implement upgrade safety: pre-apply validation checks, in-place canary rollouts for Helm releases, automated health checks (Prometheus remote_write sanity, OTEL pipeline smoke tests, Fluent Bit drain readiness), and rollback hooks for failed canaries.
- Expose variables for tiered retention (hot/warm/cold), metric scraping frequency, KV cache sizing for collector, and network egress policies.
- Emit rich observability (module-level metrics and alerts) so infra teams can debug failures early and understand cost changes post-upgrade.

Acceptance criteria:
- Module exposes a consistent Terraform interface with clear defaults and examples for EKS/GKE.
- A documented canary rollout pattern exists: subset of namespaces or k8s nodes receive new chart values, health checks run for 10 minutes, followed by a full rollout or automatic rollback.
- Automated CI plan (terraform plan + helm diff + smoke tests) is wired into infra repo.
- Security review conducted for exported credentials (S3/CloudWatch/Kafka) and KMS integration.
- Migration guide included for clusters using older handcrafted charts.

Design notes (high level):
- Use Helm provider for Terraform to manage charts; prefer stable/prometheus-operator and grafana helm charts pinned to validated chart versions.
- OpenTelemetry Collector run as StatefulSet when KV caching is enabled; otherwise as Deployment. Include an optional persistent volume for collector state when required by long-lived exporters.
- Log shipping implemented via a configurable Fluent Bit DaemonSet with plugin hooks: s3 output, cloudwatch logs, and kafka. Provide option to enable buffered local disk for intermittent network outages.
- Health checks: (1) Prometheus targets sanity (>= 95% targets UP after deploy), (2) OTEL collector self-test: loopback export + metrics ingestion verification, (3) Log shipper drain test: send synthetic event and assert delivery to configured sink.
- Upgrade path: terraform apply triggers a pre-check script (locally via ci runner) that verifies quota/limits, then performs Helm canary using weighted label selector and waits for health gates. If gate fails, module signals a failing output and CI/automation rolls back via helm rollback.

Terraform interface sketch (variables - documented in README):
- enable_prometheus = true
- enable_grafana = true
- enable_otlp_collector = true
- log_shipper = "fluentbit" (options: fluentbit, fluentd, none)
- retention_days = { hot = 7, warm = 30, cold = 365 }
- canary: { enabled = true, namespace_selector = "obs-canary", duration_minutes = 10, failure_threshold = 1 }
migration_plan: 1) Add module to infra repo as module 'observability/v1'. 2) Run terraform plan against staging clusters and validate canary workflow. 3) Execute canary on non-critical namespaces and run smoke tests. 4) Monitor module-level metrics and alerts for 48 hours. 5) Schedule rollout to production clusters (rolling per-region).
test_plan: CI steps: terraform fmt & validate; terraform plan with --target module.observability (dry-run); helm diff; deploy to ephemeral cluster; run smoke scripts: prometheus_target_check.sh, otel_collector_smoke.rb, fluentbit_drain_test.py; collect results and require green before merge.
rollout_plan: Canary rollout by label: (1) create canary namespace 'obs-canary' and deploy new chart values to 10% of nodes via nodeSelector/affinity, (2) run health checks for 10 minutes, (3) expand to 50% for 30 minutes, (4) full rollout. On failure, invoke helm rollback and open ENG-XXXXX incident stub for postmortem.
observability_contracts: Module will emit the following metrics to the monitoring account: observability.module.deploy.duration_seconds, observability.module.canary.success_count, observability.module.canary.failure_count, observability.module.last_success_timestamp. Alerts: canary-failure > 0, prometheus-targets-down > 5%
security_notes: Credentials must be supplied via TF variables referencing secrets manager (not plain-text). S3 uploads should be encrypted with customer-managed KMS. Network egress should be restricted - module will create NetworkPolicy objects that limit egress to configured exporter endpoints.
